text: 中国人民银行上海总部8月4日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，人民银行上海总部要扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策，积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求。用好各项结构性货币政策工具。贯彻落实金融“五篇大文章”1+N系列政策。推动债券市场“科技板”在上海持续见效。稳步深化金融改革和对外开放，构建完善外汇管理体制机制。落实跨境贸易投融资高水平开放、境外放款、境外上市等各项新政。
text_en: The Shanghai Head Office of the People's Bank of China (PBOC) held its second-half 2026 work conference on August 4. The meeting stressed that the Shanghai Head Office should solidly implement a moderately loose monetary policy, actively encourage financial institutions to tap into effective credit demand, and make good use of various structural monetary policy tools. It also called for implementing the 'Five Major Articles' 1+N policy series in finance, promoting the sustained effectiveness of the bond market's 'Technology Board' in Shanghai, steadily deepening financial reforms and opening-up, building and improving the foreign exchange management system, and implementing new policies for high-level opening of cross-border trade and investment financing, overseas lending, and overseas listings.
